description: This file defines the ChartService class responsible for generating various employee distribution reports and statistics in the OrangeHRM dashboard. It interacts with a ChartDao data access object to retrieve raw data and processes it to produce summarized data transfer objects for use in the application.

classes.name: ChartService
classes.description: Service class for retrieving and processing employee distribution data for dashboard visualization, including by subunit and location.

methods.name: getChartDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the ChartDao instance used for data retrieval.

methods.name: getEmployeeDistributionBySubunit
methods.description: Retrieves employee distribution data by subunit, sorts and limits the results, and prepares a DTO with aggregated 'other' counts.

methods.name: getLocationUnassignedEmployeeCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of active employees not assigned to any location based on total active employees and assigned counts.

methods.name: getEmployeeDistributionByLocation
methods.description: Retrieves employee distribution by location, calculates unassigned employees, and limits the number of locations shown.
